title: Unkey
description: Open-source API key management and rate limiting platform for building developer-facing APIs with sub-10ms global verification latency.
features: Sub-10ms global API key verification backed by Cloudflare edge caching
Granular rate limiting algorithms (sliding window, token bucket, fixed window)
Hierarchical permissions and metadata attached directly to cryptographic keys
Comprehensive audit logs, usage analytics, and quota enforcement
Self-hostable via Docker or managed cloud service
pros: Eliminates rolling your own brittle Redis-based rate limiting architecture
Instant revocation and security key lifecycle management
Generous developer tier with up to 10,000 monthly key verifications
cons: Self-hosting requires ClickHouse and Redis operational familiarity
Edge sync delays can occasionally allow slight burst over-limit
targetAudience: API product builders, SaaS founders, and engineering teams monetizing developer APIs.
